text:
Victor Hedman has 4 goals in his last ten games. He scored once all of last season, a year when he played only 33 games. At 35, with a Norris, a Conn Smythe and two Cups behind him, he's playing under 15 minutes a night and finding the net again.

Our numbers say enjoy it while it lasts. He has 4 goals on 1.15 expected and is shooting 21%, against 2% last season and a normal range of 5% to 9%. The playmaking is the steadier skill: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking from last season had him in the 92nd percentile among defensemen for primary shot assists. Evolving-Hockey was cooler, putting him around replacement level, with very strong teammates flattering his on-ice numbers.

He's also in the middle of a story he didn't write. HockeyFeed and The Hockey Writers have run pieces about tension between Hedman and Nikita Kucherov amid reports that Kucherov wants out of Tampa. Those are other outlets' rumors, and none of it shows in the results: the Lightning have won eight straight at home. We project about 9 goals. The minutes, up over a minute lately, are the thing to watch.
headline: Hedman, at 35, scoring again
